verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for it. The evidence covers cap tables, share issuance, data rooms, HRIS integration and shareholder comms, but none of it mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions. The llms.txt probe only serves content to external AI crawlers and is not an in-product AI capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
